system.description:
You enter a supernatural rage.

For the spell’s duration, you have ADV on melee attacks, and your attacks deal +[[/r 1d8]] damage.

You must make a melee attack against the creature nearest to you on your turn, even if it’s an ally. If you cannot, the spell ends.

If your deity is @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.patrons-and-deities.Item.6qeBzYJUTgrMhUcW]{Ramlaat}, cast this spell with ADV.
